_contract: The maintainer decision this formal C3 session runs under. AUTHORIZES SPEND; authorizes no launch by itself -- a launch still needs the one-use authorization issued FROM this grant, a launch-bound readiness record and a staged bundle. Every scientific and harness identity is DERIVED by issue_c3_authorization.py and REFUSED if asserted here.
granted_by: maintainer decision 2026-09-30, on independent review of the remote state after attempt66. The maintainer accepted that attempt66 is a completed formal attempt with NO behavioural result, no preserved probe weights and no C3 verdict, and authorized ONE fresh complete formal C3 nine-probe attempt as a NEW measurement -- explicitly not a resume of attempt66, and with no pooling of attempt66's probes. Conditioned on a storage cleanup and a fresh-oid capacity verification that both completed before this grant was written; see logs/maintenance/inventories/archival_retirement_20260930.json.
covers: ONE formal Phase-C3 session: replay the frozen pre-ATTENTION parent under its digest gate, gate the incumbent B, materialize three initializations once each, train 9 recovery probes (3 arms x 3 fresh seeds), evaluate each once on c1_confirmation_v1, compute the three prespecified paired contrasts with a 20,000-iteration stratified prompt-cluster bootstrap, apply the frozen decision rule to the PRIMARY contrast alone, collect evidence and tear down.
_this_is_a_new_measurement_not_a_resume: attempt66 trained all nine probes and then lost both its evaluations and its checkpoints. There is no resume contract for re-evaluating checkpoints that no longer exist, and inventing one is forbidden. This attempt therefore retrains all nine from the same frozen inputs. attempt66's probe results, of which there are none, are not pooled, spliced or referenced; its authorization and closeout are historical evidence and are not mutated.

_the_frozen_science_is_unchanged.arms: the same three -- A_incumbent, B_causal_b1, C_causal_b3
_the_frozen_science_is_unchanged.seeds: the same three preregistered recovery seeds; no fourth seed
_the_frozen_science_is_unchanged.digest_gates: the same frozen parent and incumbent digest gates
_the_frozen_science_is_unchanged.inference: the same estimands, the same 20,000-iteration bootstrap, the same decision rule
_the_frozen_science_is_unchanged._owner: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c3/plans/c3_preregistration.json, whose stamp binds its own body. Nothing in this grant restates a scientific identity; the issuer derives every one and refuses a grant that asserts any.

_what_changed_since_attempt66_is_enginee: the stage-H defect is repaired ON C3'S CALLER SIDE: the driver no longer passes --arm, whose vocabulary is C1's two roles rather than C3's three arms. scripts/autoinit/score_c1_confirmation.py is byte-identical to the attempt66 authorized base 31e17ffa and to its session commit f3a783a8 -- verified by hash, not asserted -- so the frozen C1 scorer that a completed GO experiment binds is untouched

scorer_preflight now sends every flag the real stage-H call sends, and fails loudly on argparse exit 2. It previously sent four of eight, and a flag a preflight never sends is a flag it cannot prove the scorer accepts

a durable_capacity_gate was added to the pre-provider prechecks: it asks the LFS batch endpoint, with fresh random oids, whether the relay would accept one probe AND all nine. attempt66's nine uploads were all refused for quota, and nothing had asked

the launcher's evidence_fields now DERIVE arms/seeds/probes from the preregistration. They read 2/3/6, so attempt66's session.json states two arms and six probes for a run that trained nine across three

a fourth seed, a fourth arm, arm elimination, successive halving or a forced winner

pooling, splicing or reusing anything from attempt66

any change to the frozen protocol: recovery recipe, teacher, corpus, optimizer, battery, generation protocol, scoring contract, bootstrap iterations, SESOI, guardrails or the decision rule

autonomous_pre_science_retry: PERMITTED inside this cumulative ceiling. An invocation that aborts BEFORE formal training or measurement begins is an engineering subrun, not a retried experiment: preserve and close it, diagnose, repair minimally, build a FRESH chain under a new attempt identity, and continue. The budget is cumulative across every subrun; a rerun does not reset it and a replacement resource gets no fresh allocation.
